scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @classflow/api" "npm run dev -w @classflow/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/api && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p tests
scripts.test:wechat: python -m unittest discover -s tools/wechat -p test_*.py -v && tsx tools/wechat/verify-http.mts
scripts.build: npm run build -w @classflow/api && npm run build -w @classflow/web
